evidence_slice: The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham adopted the Local Plan 2037 on 18 September 2024. Policy SPP2 identifies housing and housing-led mixed-use Site Allocation AA, Barking Riverside, with indicative net minimum capacity of 11,162 homes. The public planning_local_plan_data_02 FeatureServer exposes layer 6 named Site Allocations as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700. The current transport exposed the layer metadata but not a stable raw feature-query response; therefore the exact official allocation identifier AA is preserved and canonical parcel spatial join/materialization is delegated to local OpenCode.

field_evidence.record_class: adopted Local Plan housing and housing-led mixed-use site allocation

binding_method: adopted Local Plan exact site reference plus structured public ArcGIS polygon layer metadata; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official Local Plan and public ArcGIS metadata were accessed through web transport; raw PDF and feature-query bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
